body.name: Fixed-quota two-cohort estimator
body.construction: Using \(O_{T,\Delta}\), on \(E_T\) index each arm's assignments by tape order. For \(j\leq K_a(n_T)\), set \(X_{a,j}^{\Delta}=Y_{a,j}\mathbf 1\{D_{a,j}\leq g_{T,\Delta}\}\); for \(j\leq J_a\), set \(R_{a,j}^{\Delta}=Y_{a,j}\mathbf 1\{g_{T,\Delta}<D_{a,j}\leq h_{T,\Delta}\}\). Each indicator is computed from the recorded revelation time, with an outcome absent by \(H_T\) assigned indicator zero. Set \(M_{a,\Delta}=K_a(n_T)^{-1}\sum_{j\leq K_a(n_T)}X_{a,j}^{\Delta}\), \(U_{a,\Delta}=J_a^{-1}\sum_{j\leq J_a}R_{a,j}^{\Delta}\), and \(\widehat\tau_{T,\Delta}=(M_{1,\Delta}+U_{1,\Delta})-(M_{0,\Delta}+U_{0,\Delta})\). Set \(\widehat\tau_{T,\Delta}=0\) on \(E_T^c\).
